issues.description: The `"tp"` key initialised in the `buckets` defaultdict lambda is never written to and never read; per-confidence TP counts are recomputed from scratch on lines 89–92 using a separate list comprehension.
issues.proposed_fix: Change the defaultdict lambda on line 76 from `{"tp": 0, "total": 0}` to `{"total": 0}` and remove the unused `"tp"` key.

issues.description: The guard `if not rows` checks whether any papers exist for the run, but it should check whether any *relevant* papers exist; when all classified papers are NOT_RELEVANT the digest body is empty yet the fallback message is never written.
issues.proposed_fix: Change `if not rows:` to `if not relevant:`

issues.description: The `base_dir` computed on line 135 from the ground-truth file's directory is never used; `run_validation` is called with the script's own directory instead, so PDF paths are resolved relative to the wrong directory whenever the ground-truth file is not co-located with `validate.py`.

`response.content[0].text` accesses the `.text` attribute unconditionally on a value typed as `ContentBlock` (`TextBlock | ToolUseBlock`); `ToolUseBlock` has no `.text` attribute and would raise `AttributeError` at runtime if the model returns a non-text content block.
issues.proposed_fix: Guard the access with a type check: `block = response.content[0]; return "{" + (block.text if hasattr(block, 'text') else '')`

issues.description: When a paper has no real DOI the fetcher stores a synthetic `pmid:{pmid}` value (fetcher.py line 149); `doi_url` is then set to `https://doi.org/pmid:12345`, which is non-empty and truthy, so the paper title is hyperlinked to an invalid URL instead of rendered as plain text.
issues.proposed_fix: Change the condition to also exclude synthetic PMIDs: `doi_url = f"https://doi.org/{p['doi']}" if p["doi"] and not p["doi"].startswith("pmid:") else ""`

issues.description: `csv_path` is assigned from the `output.write_digest()` return value but is never read after assignment; only `md_path` is used in the subsequent log call.
issues.proposed_fix: Replace `md_path, csv_path = output.write_digest(...)` with `md_path, _ = output.write_digest(...)` to make the intentional discard explicit.
